'''2007 North Dakota State Championship Kurt Schlichting DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kurt Schlichting]] at [[2007 North Dakota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' bad droid pile
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
